title: HeightLimiter
description: Gives you ability to prevent spawn of specific mobs on a specific heights
body:
This is a simple mod that gives you ability to prevent spawn of specific mobs on a specific heights.

You can set global limit by list of ModIDs, or create separated groups with custom height range by modid:entity_name

IF YOU ARE USE 1.0 BEFORE PLEASE REMOVE OLD CONFIG BEFORE UPDATING TO 2.0
